notes.title: Matchmaking Update - September 27, 2017
notes.content:
We’ve been following everyone’s feedback from launch and have had some great participation from you in helping us to track down the matchmaking bugs.  We’re very happy to say that this update fixes them!

The next time you launch Steam, please verify your local files so you can be sure that you have the update.

Thank you all for feedback, and for your patience!

Sincerely,

The OddBird Team

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30274789/e34832e2d45c8caba86544d1c2189d2fa246a978.png[/img]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Arrow Heads, 20% off!
notes.content:
Arrow Heads is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Grab your friends, neighbors, extended family and that handsome cashier from the grocery store and get ready for some sweet, award-winning, couch and online multiplayer. With your trusty bow, shoot, dodge and deflect arrows in this zany isometric archery game.

*Offer ends September 28 at 10AM Pacific Time
